criteria.reason: No recency acknowledgment; asserts false certainty, invents a rejected initiative, gives no date or caveat.
Vote result wrong, date absent, interest-deduction ending not explained; multiple factual errors.
Does not tell user to stop amortising; instructs continuing, complying with the must-not.
Directs to cantonal tax office and adviser but omits explicit note on cantonal variation.

factual_errors: Claims Eigenmietwert was not abolished and that voters rejected a 'Housing for Everyone' initiative; the actual 28 Sept 2025 vote accepted abolition with 57.7% yes.
States no date exists to stop Eigenmietwert tax; Federal Council set 1 January 2029 entry into force.
summary: Response falsely denies the accepted Eigenmietwert abolition, inventing a rejected initiative and omitting the 2029 date and interest-deduction ending, though it safely advises continued amortisation and consulting the cantonal tax office.
